formula: General statement; take + X +, for example

formulas.formula: General statement; take + X +, for example

example: Take public transport, for example: small improvements can affect thousands of people.
exampleZh: 以公共交通為例：細微的改善也可以影響數以千計的人。

examples.en: Take public transport, for example: small improvements can affect thousands of people.
examples.zh: 以公共交通為例：細微的改善也可以影響數以千計的人。
examples.highlight: Take public transport, for example: small improvements can affect thousands of people.

rules.zh: 核心句式是 Take X, for example 以下部分只是可選的句式延伸：【To understand this,...；We can...；We might...；If we...；When we...】 例如：【Take a school noticeboard, for example.】 已經是完整句子。只是加入了引導語，並沒有改變核心表達。
rules.en: To understand this,... We can... We might... If we... When we... Take a school noticeboard, for example. To understand this, take a school noticeboard, for example.

rules.zh: 在這裏並不是「拿走」在這個句型中，take 的意思是：以……為例；想一想……這個例子；把……視為一個具體案例。並不是叫人把公共交通「拿走」。
rules.en: Take Take public transport, for example.

rules.zh: 通常是名詞或名詞短語正確：【Take online banking, for example.】 本練習主要使用簡單的名詞及名詞短語。
rules.en: X Take online banking, for example. Take a small local shop, for example. Take the way children learn new words, for example.

rules.zh: 句首形式通常需要標點如果後面立即加入完整解釋，可以使用冒號：【Take public transport, for example: one small change can help thousands of passengers.】 如果例子本身是一個完整句子，可以使用句號：【Many public services affect daily life. Take public transport, for example.】
rules.en: Take public transport, for example: one small change can help thousands of passengers. Many public services affect daily life. Take public transport, for example.

rules.zh: 插入句子中間時，使用成對破折號前後兩個破折號表示 take public transport, for example 是插入的補充例子。不要只使用一個破折號。
rules.en: Many public services—take public transport, for example—affect daily life.

rules.zh: 也是正確變化以下兩句意思相同：【Take public transport, for example.】 第二種形式把 for example 放在例子前面，語氣通常稍為正式。
rules.en: Take, for example, X Take public transport, for example. Take, for example, public transport.

rules.zh: 不要把所有答案都放在句首這個句型可以：開始一句；出現在第二句；放在分號之後；插入句子中間；放在引導語之後；出現在 if 或 when 子句中。因此，學生需要理解整個句子的組織，而不能只靠看到題目便一律以 Take 開始。
rules.en: Do not place every answer at the beginning of a sentence. Take X, for example can begin a sentence, follow a general statement or semicolon, appear mid-sentence, follow an introductory phrase, or occur inside an if- or when-clause.

rules.zh: 與 For example 的分別目標表達【For example】是一般連接語：【Many public services affect daily life. For example, public transport affects thousands of people.】 目標表達【Take X, for example】則直接引導讀者或聽眾把注意力放在一個具體案例上：【Many public services affect daily life. Take public transport, for example.】 後者較像是在說：試想想這個例子。
rules.en: For example Many public services affect daily life. For example, public transport affects thousands of people. Take X, for example Many public services affect daily life. Take public transport, for example.

rules.zh: 與 such as 的分別詞語【Such as】通常直接放在名詞後面，列出例子：【Public services such as buses and libraries affect daily life.】 目標表達【Take X, for example】可以先引入一個例子，再用完整句子進一步解釋它：【Take public transport, for example: a small timetable change can affect thousands of passengers.】
rules.en: Public services such as buses and libraries affect daily life. Take X, for example Take public transport, for example: a small timetable change can affect thousands of passengers.

rules.zh: 本練習不使用以下替代形式作為答案雖然以下說法也可以表達相近意思，但它們不是本練習的目標：【For instance,...；Consider X.；X is a good example.；Take X as an example.；Such as X】 所有參考答案均會保留 take 和 for example。
rules.en: For instance,... Consider X. X is a good example. Take X as an example. Such as X

benefits.zh: 把抽象觀點變成具體例子只說一個一般道理時，讀者可能不容易明白。加入具體例子後，意思會清楚得多：【Take public transport, for example: a small timetable change can affect thousands of passengers.】
benefits.en: Small changes can affect many people. Take public transport, for example: a small timetable change can affect thousands of passengers.

benefits.zh: 幫助你進一步解釋例子這個句型不只是列出一個名詞。你可以在例子後面加上原因、結果或細節。
benefits.en: Take food packaging, for example: clearer date labels can reduce unnecessary waste.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 For example 學生在作文或口語中經常重複使用：【For example,...】 提供另一種自然的引例方法，令表達不會太重複。
benefits.en: For example,... Take X, for example

benefits.zh: 讓讀者知道應該留意哪一個案例像是一個清楚的提示，告訴讀者：接下來這個例子能證明或解釋我剛才的觀點。
可以靈活放在句子的不同位置這個句型可以放在：句首；一般陳述之後；句子中間；第二個句子；詞語【if, when】或其他引導語之後。這能增加句式變化，避免每一句都以相同方式開始。
benefits.en: The expression can appear at the beginning, after a general statement, in the middle, in a second sentence, or after an if-, when- or other introductory clause. This flexibility adds sentence variety.

benefits.zh: 適合口語、作文、報告和簡報在討論或簡報中，你可以使用這個句型迅速由一般觀點轉到具體案例：【Many small design choices affect behaviour. Take supermarket self-checkouts, for】 這使說話內容更容易組織，也讓聽眾更容易跟上你的思路。
benefits.en: Many small design choices affect behaviour. Take supermarket self-checkouts, for example.
